Strategy: Usable-remainder band bonus: add a large bonus when placing the item leaves a remainder between half the item and one full item, otherwise score by tightest fit; this favors bins that stay reusable for a medium item instead of nearly closing or staying nearly empty. It can fail when the bonus overrides much tighter fits that would have closed bins cleanly.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (500.0 if (r - item >= item / 2 and r - item <= item) else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
